records.name: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University
records.description: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) in Coimbatore is one of India's premier agricultural universities, established in 1971, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in agricultural sciences, horticulture, agricultural engineering, and food technology. TNAU is ranked consistently among the top agricultural universities in India and is particularly renowned for its plant breeding, crop protection, and agro-processing research. The university operates an extensive network of regional research stations and agricultural technology demonstration centers across Tamil Nadu.

records.name: Punjab Agricultural University
records.description: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) in Ludhiana is one of Asia's leading agricultural universities, established in 1962, which played a pivotal role in India's Green Revolution by developing high-yielding wheat varieties. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in agronomy, plant breeding, entomology, soil science, and agricultural engineering. PAU maintains over 12 research stations across Punjab and has released more than 800 varieties of different crops adopted by farmers across northern India.

records.name: G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology
records.description: Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology (GBPUAT) in Pantnagar, Uttarakhand is India's first agricultural university, established in 1960 as a land-grant type institution modeled on American state universities. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in agriculture, veterinary science, engineering, and home science. Pantnagar is famous for its role in introducing high-yielding wheat varieties to India and its campus, one of India's largest, is celebrated for its research farms and agricultural extension programs.

records.name: University of Agricultural Sciences Bangalore
records.description: University of Agricultural Sciences (UAS) Bangalore is Karnataka's premier agricultural university, offering B.Sc. (Agriculture), M.Sc., and Ph.D. programs in crop sciences, horticulture, and agricultural engineering. The university is particularly known for its research in sericulture, dryland farming, and biotechnology applications in agriculture, making significant contributions to Karnataka's farming sector. UAS Bangalore operates extensive field research stations across Karnataka and provides agricultural education tailored to the state's diverse agro-climatic zones.

records.name: Lady Hardinge Medical College
records.description: Lady Hardinge Medical College (LHMC) in New Delhi is one of India's premier women's medical colleges and a central government institution affiliated with the University of Delhi. Established in 1916, it offers MBBS and postgraduate MD/MS programs and is attached to Smt. Sucheta Kriplani Hospital and Kalawati Saran Children's Hospital. LHMC is renowned for its obstetrics, gynecology, and pediatrics departments and has produced generations of leading women physicians across India.

records.name: Christian Medical College Ludhiana
records.description: Christian Medical College (CMC) Ludhiana is one of the oldest private medical institutions in Asia, established in 1894 as a mission hospital, offering MBBS, MD/MS, and nursing programs under Punjab Health Sciences University. The institution is known for its high ethical standards, strong clinical training, and social outreach, particularly in rural healthcare and women's health. CMC Ludhiana graduates are recognized internationally for their compassionate patient care and are well placed in hospitals across India and abroad.

records.name: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute
records.description: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute in Coimbatore is a leading ophthalmology specialty hospital offering clinical training and fellowship programs in various sub-specialties of eye care including cornea, retina, glaucoma, and paediatric ophthalmology. It operates a network of hospitals across Tamil Nadu and Kerala, providing students with exposure to high-volume tertiary eye care. The institute conducts outreach programs serving rural populations with preventable blindness.

records.name: Elite School of Optometry Chennai
records.description: Elite School of Optometry in Chennai, affiliated with SNDT Women's University and operated by Vision Research Foundation at Sankara Nethralaya, is one of India's premier optometry institutions offering B.Optom., M.Optom., and Ph.D. programs. Located within the Sankara Nethralaya complex, students have access to one of India's busiest and most respected eye hospitals for clinical training. The school has strong research programs in visual science, low vision rehabilitation, and contact lens practice.

records.name: LV Prasad Eye Institute
records.description: L V Prasad Eye Institute (LVPEI) in Hyderabad is one of the world's leading eye care institutions, internationally recognized for its comprehensive care, research, education, and community outreach model. It offers fellowship programs in cornea, vitreoretina, glaucoma, pediatric ophthalmology, and optometry that are among the most sought-after in Asia. LVPEI's tiered eye care model has been replicated across several countries and the institute is a WHO Collaborating Centre for prevention of blindness.

records.name: Bharati Vidyapeeth (Optometry)
records.description: Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University in Pune offers B.Optom. and M.Optom. programs in optometry through its College of Optometry, one of the few recognized optometry programs in Maharashtra. The college has modern optometric instrumentation labs and clinical training facilities integrated with Bharati Hospital. Bharati Vidyapeeth's optometry program is known for producing competent vision care practitioners serving hospitals, optical retail chains, and community eye care programs.
